hypothesis: Grafting the overGenerateScore in-context topology (exp002) onto the champion LoRA adapter v2a_e1 should combine the best inference strategy with the best model weights, yielding a quality above either alone.
technique: A matrix sweep crossing the overGenerateScore in-context pipeline (exp002 topology) with the champion LoRA adapter v2a_e1: the adapter replaces the stock base model in the expand stage, evaluated greedy on the full-30 set.
result: Scored 0.296 on the full-30 greedy gate — an improvement over the raw exp002 baseline (0.263) but well below the champion exp056 (0.440). The all-inference × best-LoRA cross did not yield the expected synergy; experiment was discarded.
